LanguageData.UMW_IntegrationGroupDesc: Everything from {0} in this section. The box switches the whole group at once; a half-filled box means some of its rows are off.
LanguageData.UMW_WeaponEnabledDesc: Allow {0} to be generated. Turn off to remove it from every reward and loot pool; the other weapons fill its place. Weapons already in your save are untouched. Some mods' own loot generators may bypass this.
LanguageData.UMW_TraitEnabledDesc: Allow {0} to roll on newly made unique weapons. Turn off to keep it out of the roll; other traits fill its place. Weapons that already carry it keep it.
LanguageData.UMW_ExcludeWoodStuffDesc: Unique weapons roll a random eligible material. With this on, wood is never rolled, so a hard-won reward never lands as a wooden {0}.
LanguageData.UMW_TraderStocksUniquesWarMerchantDesc: About half of {0} visits bring one unique melee weapon of medieval or older make for sale, and the caravan buys unique melee weapons either way. Ultratech traits never roll on its stock: a war party deals in period arms. Disabled weapons never appear.
LanguageData.UMW_TraderStocksUniquesShamanDesc: About half of {0} visits bring one unique melee weapon of medieval or older make for sale, and the caravan buys unique melee weapons either way. Ultratech traits may roll on its stock: shamans trade in relics they do not fully understand. Disabled weapons never appear.
LanguageData.UMW_TraderStocksUniquesOutlanderSettleme: Unique weapons in Outlander settlement stock
About one in five outlander settlements stocks one unique melee weapon of industrial or later make, and it buys unique melee weapons either way. Disabled weapons never appear.
LanguageData.UMW_TraderStocksUniquesCaravanDesc: About one in five {0} caravan visits brings one unique melee weapon of industrial or later make for sale, and the caravan buys unique melee weapons either way. Disabled weapons never appear.
LanguageData.UMW_TraderStocksUniquesShip: Unique weapons in {0} trade ship stock
LanguageData.UMW_TraderStocksUniquesShipDesc: About one in five {0} trade ships carries one unique melee weapon of industrial or later make for sale, and the ship buys unique melee weapons either way. Disabled weapons never appear.
LanguageData.UMW_EarthshakeCooldownDesc: Rest time between earthshakes. The default matches the EMP pulser from {0}. 0 removes the cooldown.
LanguageData.UMW_EarthshakeRadiusDesc: Reach of the stunning shockwave. Walls do not stop it; gaps with no floor do. It is indiscriminate: a wider radius catches your own colonists too.
LanguageData.UMW_RallyingCryCooldownDesc: Rest time between rallying cries. Measured in days on purpose: the default makes it an heirloom moment, not a standing aura re-applied every fight.
LanguageData.UMW_RallyingCryRadiusDesc: How far the cry carries. Rallies every non-hostile humanlike in range with line of sight; blocked by walls. Also wakes sleepers.
LanguageData.UMW_RalliedDurationDesc: How long the rallied buff lasts, halving pain and stagger time. Sleepers are woken instead, and resent it.
LanguageData.UMW_WarbandQuestWeightDesc: How often the warband quest is offered against the other opportunity-site quests (ancient mercenaries, bandit camps, item stashes...). Higher = offered more often. 0 disables it.
LanguageData.UMW_MatchVteSpearDesc: {1} draws the vanilla spear diagonally and longer. With this on, the {0} is turned and enlarged to match it in a drafted pawn's hands. Purely cosmetic. Takes effect after a restart.
